tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground of every screen and sheet. Pure white and pure black; tinted themes (Flex only) lean faintly toward the seed.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Fill of every card (radius-card). One step above bg; no border, no shadow.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Wells on a card and inactive controls: segmented track, idle round buttons, icon buttons, inactive chart bars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Separator, only where one cannot be avoided. Prefer air between rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, numbers, titles and every category that is not recovery or heart. Reads on bg, card and fill in all themes (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, units, time stamps, subs, inactive segment and tab labels. On bg, card, fill: 5.1:1 or more in all themes.

tokens.name: ink3
tokens.usage: Chevrons, chart axis labels (11px), placeholders. Below 3:1 on card and fill in every theme (light 2.3:1 on card): exact from the source, never use for text that must be read.

tokens.name: solid
tokens.usage: The one strong fill: chosen tab, active round button, the main action. Inverts per theme.

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Icon and label on solid.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Opaque face of floating capsules (bar, header pills, search). With glass on, use one of the glass-* tokens instead.

tokens.name: glass-frosted
tokens.usage: Glass level 0 (default): bar at 40 % (dark 42 %) over a 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-clearer
tokens.usage: Glass level 1: bar at 20 % (dark 22 %) over the blur.

tokens.name: glass-clear
tokens.usage: Glass level 2: bar at 8 % (dark 10 %) over the blur.

tokens.name: glass-web
tokens.usage: Horizont: capsule over its own screens with blur, 72 % (dark 62 %). Over a web page there is no blur: use bar, opaque.

tokens.name: bar-rim
tokens.usage: 0.8px inner rim of every glass capsule.

tokens.name: recovery
tokens.usage: Recovery category: its icon, label, gauge arc, positive chart marks. Derived from the seed hue (HCT chroma 48, tone 42 / dark 80); shown for Pulse blue #3f5bd9. 4.7:1 or more on bg, card, fill.

tokens.name: recovery-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind recovery marks, e.g. a highlighted For You card or day-score chip. Text on it is ink or recovery (5.1:1).

tokens.name: heart
tokens.usage: Heart category and heart-rate marks. #ff2d55 harmonized toward the seed, chroma 62/56, tone 46/76. 4.7:1 on card; light on fill only 4.2:1, keep text off fill.

tokens.name: heart-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind heart marks. heart on heart-bg is 4.45:1 in light, short of 4.5 for small text: exact from the source.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Longevity only: years gained, a good delta. Always with a sign (+) or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Longevity only: years lost, a bad delta. Always with a sign (−) or word.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: What is chosen or acts. Mono: solid. Flex (tinted themes, and Horizont Flex): the colourway's accent.

tokens.name: on-active
tokens.usage: Icon and label on active.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title, top left. Draw the missing weight as a 1.2px stroke in the text colour (class im-serif).

styles.name: page-statement
styles.sample: You slept well, four nights in a row
styles.usage: The one-sentence verdict at the head of a detail page. Stroke 1.1px.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heading above a block (For You, Days). Stroke 1.0px. 14px below it the content starts.

styles.name: serif-statement
styles.usage: Serif statement outside cards. Stroke 0.9px. Inside a card the statement is in Inter (statement).

styles.name: number-hero
styles.usage: Body age.

styles.name: number-gauge
styles.usage: Number inside the recovery gauge.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: The one number of a card. Unit follows in unit style after a space.

styles.name: number-small
styles.usage: Numbers in grids and ring legends.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Past halfway to your step goal
styles.usage: The sentence inside a card, 12px under the header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Observations from the last three months.
styles.usage: Running text, list row titles.

styles.name: sub
styles.usage: Second line in ink2.

styles.name: category
styles.usage: Card header label, in the category colour (recovery, heart, else ink).

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Segment and tab labels; chosen in ink (or on-solid), others ink2.

styles.name: pill-title
styles.usage: Title in a floating header pill.

styles.name: unit
styles.usage: Unit after a number, ink2.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Label above a number, under a round button; ink2.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Time stamp in card headers, quiet notes below cards; ink2.

styles.name: axis
styles.usage: Labels along the foot of a chart, ink3, 8px under it.

styles.name: flex-title
styles.usage: Insights Flex page title: also ROND 100 and wdth 104 (class im-round).

styles.name: flex-heading
styles.usage: Flex section heading; ROND 100, wdth 104.

styles.name: flex-statement
styles.usage: Flex card statement; ROND 30. Flex letter-spacing is half of Mono's.

styles.name: flex-body
styles.usage: Every Inter style maps to Google Sans Flex at the same size, ROND 30, opsz = size.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Card padding left, top, right (bottom 20px); card header to chart; rows in a list card.

tokens.name: space-card-gap
tokens.usage: Between cards on the Insights page.

tokens.name: space-card-bottom
tokens.usage: Card bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-statement
tokens.usage: Card header to statement; between round button and its neighbours; header pill to actions.

tokens.name: space-block
tokens.usage: Section heading to content; between advice sentences.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between page sections (cards to For You, For You to Days).

tokens.name: space-shortcuts
tokens.usage: Shortcut row to the first card; 28px above the row, under the header.

tokens.name: space-icon
tokens.usage: Category icon to its label; tab icon to label.

tokens.name: space-label
tokens.usage: Label above a number.

tokens.name: space-bar-gap
tokens.usage: Between the tab capsule and the + capsule.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: 44px header pills (back, title, actions).

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: 50px tab slot in the bar.

tokens.name: radius-search
tokens.usage: 52px search pill.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: 60px floating bar and its + capsule; the default glass radius.

tokens.name: radius-segmented
tokens.usage: Segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Segmented thumb (track radius minus 3px padding).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Small marks: dots in a strip, chart chips.

tokens.name: radius-bar-mark
tokens.usage: Top corners of chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round buttons, circle buttons, gauge caps.

shadow.note: Only floating things cast shadows; cards never do. In the app the shadow is painted outside the clip only, so frosted glass shows no grey patch.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Every glass capsule at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-bar-lifted
tokens.usage: A capsule held up by a finger (lift 1).

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Segmented thumb at rest; while dragged 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.24) and scale 1.08.

tokens.name: shadow-tab-lifted
tokens.usage: Chosen tab while dragged along the bar (scale 1.1).

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: Floating bar height; the + capsule is 60 × 60.

tokens.name: size-bar-tabs
tokens.usage: Width of the tab capsule; the bar is 308px, centred.

tokens.name: size-tab
tokens.usage: Tab slot height; inactive slots 48px wide, the chosen one takes the rest.

tokens.name: size-round
tokens.usage: Round shortcut button (icon 26px), label 8px below.

tokens.name: size-circle
tokens.usage: Circle button of a page header (icon 24px).

tokens.name: size-pill
tokens.usage: Header pills and the segmented control.

tokens.name: size-search
tokens.usage: Search pill above the bar.

tokens.name: size-icon-card
tokens.usage: Category icon in a card header.

tokens.name: size-icon-bar
tokens.usage: Tab and search icons.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur (sigma 16) behind glass capsules. One blur behind the whole bar, not one per capsule.
